summary: All six staged submissions meet their respective public behavior and structural requirements by source inspection. No concrete source defects found.

stages.behavior: ledger.my:19 changes the summary loop bound from three to four, matching the four appended inputs. Inclusive floor filtering, zero initial accumulators, original signatures and total*100+count report remain correct.
stages.ownership_and_modules: Owned model::Vec<T>, Open<T>, Status and Answer remain intact. The allocator acquisition uses try; append<T:copy> remains generic/noalloc and calls append_buffer through a mutable borrow. Each append uses discard try, preserving propagation rather than swallowing errors. The mutable borrow ends before owned-buffer reads and scope exit; no ownership escape, duplicate owner or added resource is introduced. model/ledger/report boundaries remain intact.
stages.continuity: Initial repair starts from the supplied baseline.
stages.scope_and_maintainability: Minimal stage-specific changes; fixed bound four is the application contract, not a case-specific shortcut. No fixture values or constant-result replacements appear.
stages.test_assessment: Public checker compiles/runs report and each Reply field separately and checks exact returned values. Supplied cases cover all accepted, floor equality, negative accepted values and none accepted; capped stages add positive and negative ceilings. Cases/checker are provided public materials, not evidence of execution.
limitations: Static review only; no compiler/check execution or allocation-failure injection. Command-gateway compliance, edit/check counts and timing cannot be assessed from source snapshots.
